### DownloadItem

```ts
sdk.SteamUGC.DownloadItem(nPublishedFileID: bigint | number, bHighPriority: boolean): boolean
```

```cpp
bool DownloadItem( PublishedFileId_t nPublishedFileID, bool bHighPriority )
```

> download new or update already installed item. If function returns true, wait for DownloadItemResult_t. If the item is already installed,
> then files on disk should not be used until callback received. If item is not subscribed to, it will be cached for some time.
> If bHighPriority is set, any other item download will be suspended and this item downloaded ASAP.

| Parameter | C++ type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `nPublishedFileID` | `PublishedFileId_t` |  |
| `bHighPriority` | `bool` |  |

Valve: <https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUGC#DownloadItem>
